criteria.criterion: 高优先级任务先于低优先级任务执行
criteria.evidence: PrioritizedTask/UrgentTask compareTo or Task queue comparator sorts larger priority before smaller priority among waiting work. Running work is not preempted.

criteria.criterion: 过载淘汰最旧任务且不误删最高优先级任务
criteria.evidence: baseline/rag use an unbounded PriorityBlockingQueue(200), so finite capacity is not enforced. rules uses a descending TreeSet: its eviction traversal breaks on higher-priority items and otherwise overwrites the victim through newer sequence numbers. Frozen acceptance fails for all three outputs.
